recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多中大型細胞的細胞質布滿空泡，另有前驅細胞含粗大紅色巨大顆粒（中上方）；空泡化的組織球樣細胞增多，提示 Chediak-Higashi 症候群合併加速期（HLH 樣）變化。
features: Numerous medium to large cells with prominently vacuolated cytoplasm (histiocytes/monocytoid cells)
Occasional precursors with coarse red-orange giant granules
Admixed granulocytic precursors with coarse granules and small dark erythroid precursors
Hemodilute background with abundant red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with numerous medium to large cells containing abundant vacuolated cytoplasm, consistent with activated histiocytes/monocytoid cells. Occasional granulocytic precursors contain coarse, abnormally large red-orange granules, and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are admixed. Definite engulfment of intact hematopoietic cells is not clearly demonstrated in this field. Findings are consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome and suggest an accelerated (HLH-like) phase with histiocytic activation.

ddx.vs: Familial HLH lacks giant granules in granulocytes; genetic testing for PRF1/UNC13D/STX11 versus LYST confirms.
Monoblasts/promonocytes are immature with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are clonal by flow, unlike mature vacuolated histiocytes.
Griscelli causes albinism with HLH but lacks giant cytoplasmic granules; hair shaft shows large uneven pigment clumps.
